college_info.name: Lovely Professional University (LPU)
college_info.location: Jalandhar - Delhi G.T. Road, Phagwara, Punjab, India

B.Tech CSE.eligibility_details: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and English + valid LPUNEST / JEE Main / CUET score.

B.Tech ECE.eligibility_details: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and English + valid LPUNEST / JEE Main / CUET score.

BBA.eligibility_details: 10+2 in any stream with English from a recognized board + LPUNEST / CUET.

MBA.eligibility_details: Bachelor's degree in any discipline + valid LPUNEST / CAT / MAT / XAT / CMAT + Video Essay & Interview.

AC.amenities: Air conditioning, 750 free electricity units, attached washroom, Wi-Fi, study table, 24/7 power backup.

Non-AC.amenities: Air cooler, 350 free electricity units, Wi-Fi, study table, geyser, 24/7 campus security.

scholarships.name: LPUNEST / Qualifying Marks Merit Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Top LPUNEST score bands (Category A+/A) or 90%+ aggregate in 10+2 / Graduation
scholarships.benefit: Up to 50% to 70% programme fee waiver

scholarships.name: Financial Aid for SC/ST/OBC & Economically Weaker Students
scholarships.criteria: Eligible category / income certificates or National Scholarship Portal (NSP) schemes
scholarships.benefit: Up to 100% tuition fee support as per government & university norms

documents: Class 10th & 12th Marksheets and Passing Certificates (plus Graduation for PG)
Entrance Exam Scorecard (LPUNEST / JEE Main / CUET / CAT)
